skills.lede: Skills are steering, and they are files. Oxagen does not run a skill: the harness does. This tab lists the skills each wrapped harness session reported when it started.

inventory.title: Skills sessions reported
inventory.window: Sessions started {from} to {to}: {sessions, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}.
inventory.reported: {reported, plural, one {# session reported its skills} other {# sessions reported their skills}}.
inventory.noneReported: No session in this window reported its skills.
inventory.notReported: {count, plural, one {# session reported no inventory} other {# sessions reported no inventory}}.

row.sessions: {count} of {total, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}

empty.title: No skill reported in this window
empty.hint: Enroll a machine with oxagen agent enroll: every wrapped session reports the skills its harness had when it started.

denied.title: You cannot see the skills of this workspace
denied.body: Your roles on this workspace do not include {permission}. An owner can grant it.

pending.title: Access to this workspace’s skills is waiting for approval

error.title: Skills could not be loaded
error.body: Nothing was changed. Runs keep recording while this page is down.
